correctness.rationale: For all m,n>=3, diameter-two geodesic obstruction is exactly an induced P3. Exhaustive structural enumeration of legal third moves gives the counts n-2+2(m-1), m-2+2(n-1), and (m-2)(n-2)+2. Every third-move class has a uniquely determined terminal geometric family: complete row, complete column, maximum partial permutation, or 2x2 rectangle. This proves the exact rational type probabilities and within-family equiprobability. Elementary limits prove square-board 4/3 mean deficit and variance coefficient and fixed-width Bernoulli limit. A standalone distance-based exact Fraction state recursion exhausts all reachable states on six boards and agrees with the formulas; numerical checks are finite corroboration.

value.rationale: An exact terminal law for a natural non-adversarial variant of the established general-position game, in every complete-graph direct product with m,n>=3, is a motivated distributional invariant not supplied by static GP-set counts. The contrast between almost-sure maximum-size completion on balanced growing boards and a constant expected deficit/linear variance, versus a Bernoulli proportional-size limit for fixed width, makes the precise random transition law consequential. Type-level probabilities and exact finite distributions for every board are nontrivial structural information, not known-polynomial recomputation.
